title: Election overview and site-wide review
items: Added a results-first landing page and consistent navigation to the election map, Wu comparisons, and community-factor analysis, including on mobile.
Simplified charts and explanations; retained methods, downloads, and source links without adding a coefficient display.
Independently reproduced all 18 Wu comparison estimates and 34 community-factor estimates and intervals; checked cross-page vote counts and crosswalk weights.
Corrected source descriptions and clarified that precinct associations do not establish voter ideology, endorsement effects, or independent demographic causes.

title: Community context added to the precinct map
items: Added eight selectable Census and ACS context views directly on the election map.
Kept the precinct result visible with B, L, or close-race markers while demographic shading is active.
Added precinct-versus-district-median comparisons, city summaries, source-linked downloads, and uncertainty notes.
Made the block assignment, block-group crosswalk, precinct estimates, data dictionary, and QA report available as downloadable data.

title: Certified post-recount precinct results
items: Replaced all 59 pre-recount contest rows with the Secretary of the Commonwealth's post-recount precinct export.
Reconciled the map, table, municipal totals, and headline to 12,293 Brownsberger votes and 12,258 Lander votes.
Updated other or write-in, blank, and Democratic contest-ballot counts where the hand recount changed them.
Made each published data update bypass older cached snapshots after the site is republished.

title: Analysis and accessibility improvements
items: Added two-way table sorting and moved Brownsberger percentage before vote count.
Clarified the result-map thresholds and added a turnout-only map view.
Added municipal Brownsberger percentages plus Census and primary-participation research links.
